A low-pass filter passes low frequencies and attenuates high ones. The cutoff
frequency is the point where the output falls to 70.7 percent of the input amplitude.
Build a first-order RC low-pass filter.
Measure the gain at ten frequencies.
Compare the measured cutoff with the calculated cutoff.
